source_ownership_review.ownership_basis: ClrModePop assigns zero to all 20 indexes of both counter vectors (i=0..19). DoAntSimA, DoAntSimR, and the B-list task producer increment those vectors from list mode/task fields. TallyModePop assigns every output index 0..5 of both six-element summary vectors from fixed counter indexes. The main DoAntSim path orders clear, simulation passes, then tally. This is one named simulation-cycle owner graph, not an address-neighbor grouping.
